items.headline: $HYPE whale opens $26M leveraged long-short
items.summary: A Tornado Cash-funded wallet moved onchain and built a $26M leveraged position on Hyperliquid, pairing a major long with a short.

items.headline: $ATOM wallets hit as Keplr confirms breach
items.summary: Keplr confirmed Web3Auth recovery addresses after a wallet breach tied to a six-account Cosmos Hub batch of 2,265 staked $ATOM.

items.headline: $STX tops Bitcoin layers with $88.9M DeFi TVL
items.summary: Stacks led $BTC-layer networks in Q3 DeFi TVL at $88.9M, putting $STX back on the BTCFi radar.

items.headline: Roger Ver $BCH buy? $163K swap raises eyebrows
items.summary: A suspicious $163K swap revived talk that Roger Ver is accumulating $BCH again, putting whale-watchers on alert.

items.headline: $SHIB community seeks answers as Shibarium goes quiet
items.summary: Shibarium’s official account went silent, unsettling $SHIB holders and sparking fresh questions about network communications.
